hypothesis: N journeys can run at the same time and each one still measures what it measured alone: no instrumentation errors, the same verdict as a solo run, an egress identity that holds for the whole run, and a per-session cost that stays sub-linear.

metrics.description: Concurrent sessions that completed without an instrumentation error
Concurrent sessions whose verdict matched the same journey run solo
Concurrent sessions whose egress identity was verified to hold for the whole run
Mean wall clock per concurrent session, as a multiple of the same journey run solo
Peak resident MB across the browser process tree, per concurrent session
